page: Microsoft Azure E64pds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the Epdsv6 family, powered by an ARM-based Microsoft Neoverse-N2 processor. This server features 64 dedicated physical cores and 64 vCPUs running at 3.4 GHz, with a single thread per core configuration. It is equipped with 512 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8 GB per core. Additionally, the instance includes 3780 GB of local SSD storage and is capable of utilizing Premium Storage.

In benchmark evaluations, the E64pds_v6 demonstrates top-tier multi-core and memory performance. The multi-core stress-ng and Geekbench tests place this server in the top 10% of tested instances. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient, with uncached large-block read speeds reaching 465.82 GB/sec and write speeds at 203.93 GB/sec, both ranking in the top tier. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression and software compilation with Clang also achieve top-tier results. Single-core performance, however, sits in the average range.

Given its high memory density, dedicated ARM cores, and substantial local storage, the E64pds_v6 offers strong qualitative cost efficiency for resource-intensive workloads. It is highly suited for large-scale database operations, Redis deployments, static web serving, and multi-threaded software compilation. The absence of hyperthreading ensures predictable performance for memory-bound enterprise applications and data processing pipelines.
